about: A JavaScript library that turns code diffs into readable, colour-highlighted web pages.

prs.title: Non-English file names show properly
prs.broken: Git writes names with accents or other non-English letters as coded number sequences. diff2html showed those codes, like /303/274, instead of the real name.
prs.changed: Those quoted names are now decoded back into the real characters.
prs.matters: Files named in any language appear with their real names.

prs.title: File names with spaces keep their highlighting
prs.broken: For files with a space in the path, git adds an invisible tab after the name. diff2html kept it, so the file type was lost and code was not highlighted.
prs.changed: That trailing tab is now dropped from file names.
prs.matters: Diffs of files in folders like "My Docs" show clean names and proper colours.
